notes.title: "Do...Do you want to see me again?"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11881867/fc3424021a1fa456fef3d6f78b73d2bc8771f82d.png[/img]

The Kickstarter for [url=http://kck.st/44s6WOj]Mystic Destinies: Rebirth – Gales of Hikaru[/url] is almost over TOMORROW! It’s a new project, but it carries the same heart that made characters like Tatsuya possible. 

This is a chance to help fund not just a new project, but my return to all the stories I’ve started and still want to finish.

Backer rewards include:

[list]
[*] Early access to the new demo
[*] Exclusive short stories
[*] Live writing classes
[*] And a chance to help keep stories like this going
[/list]
If this story meant something to you—if [i]he[/i] did—this is the time.

— Aja

notes.title: Goodbye for Now—or Maybe See You Soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11881867/e9a375b7cf9c392956c98bcb9142a556ec27b5bb.jpg[/img]

This isn’t a guarantee of what he’ll look like—but it’s how he could.

The Kickstarter for [url=http://kck.st/44s6WOj]Mystic Destinies: Rebirth – Gales of Hikaru[/url] ends in just over a day. It’s something new—but built on the same foundation that brought characters like Shou into being.

Backer rewards include:

[list]
[*] Early access to the new demo
[*] Exclusive short stories
[*] Live writing classes
[*] A chance to help me keep telling stories like this
[/list]
If you’ve ever cared about him—or just want to see me finish what I started and bring more—this is the time.  

Thanks for trying Mystic Destinies!

— Aja

notes.title: Perfect PRISM Kickstarter Launched!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11881867/c2f874e33d82bc0cc31de90ed6d5615d709567cb.jpg[/img]

Hi all, I wanted to let you know about my next potential project, Perfect PRISM. It's a standalone, short futuristic game about two imperfect beings expected to be perfect  - an android and a celebrity idol - who fall in love. It'd be my first solo visual novel game and a vast departure from my MDSOA work, especially with the visual art in-game which features simple, comic-style 2D art, but if you enjoyed MDSOA, you might like to check it out! 

[h2][b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aeondreamstudios/perfect-prism]Perfect PRISM is live on Kickstarter here![/url][/b][/h2]
- Ajané

notes.title: Mystic Destinies: Echoes Now In-Development On Itch.Io
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11881867/93fc31e54d387a7701d836bf39246bfd7a541d39.png[/img]

The spin-off sequel to Mystic Destinies: Serendipity of Aeons is being released in incremental updates on Itch.io here: https://aeondreamstudios.itch.io/mde

Many people are probably wondering if it will be brought to Steam, and the answer is: Maybe, if I can get the funding for a programmer to help me port the game. I may also consider sharing Steam keys at that time, but no guarantees. For now, if you're interested in playing it as it's developed, you can check it out on Itch.io. 

- Ajané

notes.title: Aeon Dream Mini Update: August 25th
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11881867/a7cd16ad98b1f50d18d4a3598639970c81dfefce.jpg[/img]

Hello, everyone! 

Time for an update! Some good news, some not so good news. So let’s get right to it: 

[b]Mystic Destinies: Serendipity of Aeons Deluxe Edition:[/b]

Unfortunately, the Mystic Library won’t be included in the MDSOA Deluxe version upon release. We lost our server that contained our internal wiki some time ago, and despite working diligently to get it back, we were informed by the provider that everything was deleted :(

It was a tough loss for us, but we’ve begun anew with a different service and have already started working on rewriting all of the lost data, but we lost two years worth of world building and data, so, unfortunately, that will take some time to do.

Because of the immense amount of missing information, we can’t give a precise estimate on when it will be completed, but you should be able to expect an update sometime in 2018. As soon as everything is rewritten, we will update the Mystic Library as an update. This update will be completely free to all owners of the Deluxe version!

[b]Additional updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] The MDSOA artbook is almost complete!
[*] We hope to have the Deluxe Version out in very early September, as nearly all the creative work is completed.
[*] We’re doing our best to have Mystic Destinies: Echoes out by the end of September, so we’ll continue working hard![/list]

[i]If you are a backer, you will receive additional updates about your rewards through Kickstarter or if you are a Paypal backer, through Paypal. [/i]

Thank you for your understanding and support, everyone!

notes.title: Mini Update: July 28th
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11881867/a7cd16ad98b1f50d18d4a3598639970c81dfefce.jpg[/img]

Hello, Dreamers! We’re back with another bi-weekly update! 
 

First things first, a clarification for anyone who’s still confused: [u][i]Shou’s route improvement will be updated for everyone, regardless of if you get the deluxe version or not.[/i][/u] 

[list]
[*] The writing for Shou’s route improvement is going well. We can now say that there will be [b]two new bad ends[/b] for you to find! And the first extra Shou CG has been finished. Can you guess which scene it might be?

[*] We are done with the official MDSOA Walkthrough, [i]complete with all the new answers that will be coming with Shou’s route improvements[/i]. It will be sent out to backers soon!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11881867/d28f5397a79880a28a5bdeb2eebfaf0ecdaae0ef.jpg[/img]

[*]And we have finished all OC sprite rewards for backers! The third and final backer OC who will be appearing in Echoes is Chieko. She’s the cousin of Isao and Emi.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11881867/c93dab8ee5631b1e29bf637affca3171517b1a4a.jpg[/img]
[i]Meet Chieko Matsuda![/i]

[*]With Echoes, there will be no Dark, Passionate and Mystic endings. To suit the darker tone of the game, there will be a new set of endings: Divine and Chaos. Along with a yet to be determined number of bad ends.

[/list]

notes.title: Hikaru Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11881867/72fec1448f6865b2f872f39d1a0f26c8f417709b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Could a BTS inspired VN be in Aeon Dream's Future?
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11881867/77473f67016e12fc9c6edaac789d42c260fa86d9.png[/img]

[h1]We have decided to pursue the possibility of developing BTS inspired visual novels![/h1] 

We are asking for the help of BTS’ fans, ARMY and anyone else who would be interested in seeing such a game by clicking on “Support” on [url=https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/50829-call-to-army-for-bts-games?locale=en]Thunderclap[/url], using the hashtag [b]#ARMYWantsBTSGames[/b] on Tumblr, Twitter, and Facebook and most importantly voting “Yes” in [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc_EUSALbdFM86E1Zis1tHkV-6SuRRYLAMduV385UFWYAU2QA/viewform]our survey[/url]!  
You can also [url=https://twitter.com/AeonDreamStudio/status/804217534933245952]retweet our tweet we made to BTS[/url] to let them know! Please also [url=http://aeondreamstudios.tumblr.com/post/154043340919/ads-has-an-announcement-to-make-after-much]reblog this post on Tumblr[/url]to share the word!

If there’s enough demand, we’ll show BigHit [b]#ARMYWantsBTSGames[/b] and try to get some BTS games developed!

notes.title: Shou's Epilogue now available!
notes.content:
Yesterday Shou's epilogue was released! 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/455530/
But there were some kinks that affected the main game's playability so we decided to keep a stable release up until we worked them out. After testing we've determined that all achievements are unlockable. 

If you have purchased the epilogue, it is playable through the epilogue button now present on Shou's character screen. 

If you have any other issues after this point, please leave them in the Game Updates forum. There is a bug thread there that we keep an eye on. If you post a new thread in general it will take longer for us to see it. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this has caused. 

[h1] Patch Notes[/h1] 
[list][*] Three achievements added to Shou's main story, one to Shou's epilogue 
[*] Five trading cards added 
[*] Sprite added: Phoenix girl 
[*] Sprite added: Chisaki Yukimura 
[*] Sprite added: Matsuda 
[*] Typos fixed 
[*] Shou's Epilogue option added to menu (it can be purchased on Steam or in the game)

notes.title: Game update, extra content, and epilogue coming!
notes.content:
Hi there everyone! We've been so excited that so many of you enjoyed Shou's route. But we haven't stopped working, so we have some new things to announce.

[h1]Short Story/Comics[/h1]
Due to player demand, we've decided to release extra content for purchase in the form of short stories and possibly comics. This content will be $0.99 or free for [url=https://www.patreon.com/starmaidengames?ty=h] Patreon [/url] supporters, but will NOT be necessary to understanding or enjoying the character's routes. This is simply extra insight into the characters while we work on developing the game over the course of the next year for players who don't want to wait.

Our first story is a short story from Hikaru's POV and focuses on his meeting Tatsuya and Shinji. [url=https://gumroad.com/l/ugvU]Read more about it here.[/url]

[h1]Shou's Epilogue[/h1]
Shou will have a purchasable epilogue that takes place a few months after his route's end. You will get to see the main character's family and there's plenty of new sprites and a planned CG to behold! (Here's a little secret: It will also help to lead into our potential, unofficially unanounced sequel to the game if we're able to do one!). The price is tentatively set at $1.99. 

[h1]Game Update[/h1]
And last but definitely not least, we will be updating Shou's Main Story with some fixes and new content in the form of additional sprites. The sprites to be added are:
- The Dark Phoenix girl.
- Chisaki Yukimura.
- Matsuda 

We're going to do our best to release the game updates and Shou's epilogue around the same time, so please look forward to that in March!
